newsitem.title: GREECE: Greece raised 503 bln drs from T-bill sale.
newsitem.headline: Greece raised 503 bln drs from T-bill sale.

text.p: Greece raised a total of 503 billion drachmas from the sale of 12-month T-bills on Monday, a finance ministry official told Reuters.
The 12-month T-bills went on sale for one-day on Monday and featured a 50 basis point cut in rates to 11.50 percent.
About 336 billion drachmas came from book entry T-bills and the rest from the sale of physical securities, the official said. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
